title: Published chat package imports an API export removed before its rebuild
surface: Extension WXT build consuming published @ai-matrx packages
auth_mode: guest/member/admin; build is independent of sign-in
role_org_permissions: Package build validation; runtime identity and organization are not exercised
reproduction: Run CI checks on exact source fbd8713e7 (run 38274879341).
Install, Typecheck, Lint, unit tests and guest guard pass; WXT build encounters chat dist imports of logApiTarget from @ai-matrx/api root.
The API package root does not export logApiTarget, so bundling stops with MISSING_EXPORT.
expected: The latest published chat package resolves all imports against the latest published API package and the extension build completes.
actual: Published chat 0.8.64 still imports the removed API-root symbol in run-ai-stream.js and execute-manual-instance.thunk.js; WXT fails before native acceptance.
cause: Chat 0.8.64 was published from aidream commit 45e0e9d182, which used the old API-root import. Chat source commit 9a02a81c6a later moved both imports to its own host/log-api-target. The earlier package workflow used a source snapshot older than that correction; automatic chat 0.8.65 publication subsequently included it.
sibling_census: The published chat tarball contains two old logApiTarget imports, and current chat source has two corrected local imports. No extension host import of that symbol was found; repair belongs to the chat package release.
evidence: https://github.com/armanisadeghi/matrx-extend/actions/runs/38274879341: WXT MISSING_EXPORT on both published chat thunk paths against API 0.1.10.
aidream release commit 1cc0c91978 says chat 0.8.64 was published from 45e0e9d182; that source imports logApiTarget from @ai-matrx/api.

aidream commit 9a02a81c6a changes both chat thunks to ../../../../host/log-api-target and adds that local module. Automatic publish run 38269271283 used head c1a92de76c, which contains the correction, and its chat job succeeded; npm metadata now advertises 0.8.65.

npm registry tarball GET for chat 0.8.65 returned 404 at 16:16-16:19 UTC despite metadata/integrity being visible; chat 0.8.64 tarball GET returned 200 and registry.npmjs.com returned the same 404 for 0.8.65. By 16:22 UTC a real registry GET returned 200, establishing bounded propagation lag.

Automatic publish run 38269271283 uploaded https://github.com/AI-Matrix-Engine/aidream/actions/runs/38269271283/artifacts/11759245545 (npm-tarball-chat-0.8.65). The contained TGZ SHA-512 is ZcFEE0L0kOYEA+D23xDxoIdBerwANrOsWSRU291lWbXTKgWJPxp38YuQWRnprFSgS5ECmUAiKV0NpwTUQDP1Tg==, exactly matching npm dist.integrity. A later real npm pack fetched the same SHA-512 from the registry; both thunk files import ../../../../host/log-api-target.js.

Latest-only extension lockfile refresh resolves chat 0.8.65, agents 0.59.77 and associations 0.14.47 with no duplicate @ai-matrx package versions; frozen lockfile-only install passes. The published chat 0.8.65 tarball changelog and local agents/associations changelogs say no consumer action required. Fresh CI build remains pending.

aidream .github/actions/npm-publish-one/action.yml Hold the lane until npm serves step checks npm metadata gitHead and dist-tag, but does not fetch dist.tarball; its green verdict can precede a usable tarball.
Published chat 0.8.64 dist files in the extension's installed node_modules match the CI failing import; API root has no logApiTarget export.

https://github.com/armanisadeghi/matrx-extend/actions/runs/38277687185: exact-main 0b912a3fc215b840e803cb97ce82f9006c14e4e1 passed fresh install, Typecheck, Lint, unit suite, guest observer, WXT keyed development build, artifact provenance and resource guard. The prior MISSING_EXPORT did not reproduce. This is source/build evidence, not native guest or Store acceptance.

Independent Luna package graph review approved the latest-only 0.8.65 adoption and verified the fetched tarball exports and corrected local import targets. Development artifact 11759653605 was digest-verified and promoted from that run; receipt test-results/ci-dev-promotion-receipt.json identifies 0.2.509 and source/tree hashes. Chrome reload remains unverified.
reproducibility_count: Exact-source CI WXT build failure 1/1; local published artifact inspected
reviewer: Independent Luna package graph review A/A of the published tarball, latest-only lockfile and exact-source build plan; exact CI later passed.
next_action: Build defect closed only. Native guest/member behavior, Store ZIP scan, dashboard state and release gates remain separate open work. Do not dispatch/publish while spend gate is red.
